summary: Diameter Credit Company filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing credit and security facility. Amendment No. 5 reduces the maximum facility from $650M to $500M and the accordion from $800M to $600M, extends the reinvestment period from Jan 2027 to Jan 2029, and extends maturity from Jan 2029 to Jan 2031. This is a routine refinancing/amendment of a secured credit facility, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, restructuring, liquidation, or other event-driven category is present. The filing is purely operational, adjusting credit terms with no change in control or market-moving corporate action.
